    margin = a / 2.0
    pts = []

        x = x0

            x += dx
        row += 1
        y += dy
    return np.array(pts)

    """Radii = min(distance to border, half nearest neighbor distance)."""
    n = centers.shape[0]

        nearest = d.min(axis=1)
        radii = np.minimum(border, 0.5 * nearest)
    else:

    radii = np.maximum(radii, 0.0)
